select distinct pb.id, b.id as book_id, b.name, b.standard_id from book b , permission_book pb where pb.book_id = b.id
and b.id = #{dto.bookId}
and b.name like CONCAT('%', #{dto.bookName}, '%')
and pb.user_id = #{dto.userId} and b.deleted = 'n' and pb.deleted = 'n'

select distinct b.* from book b where b.deleted = 'n'
and b.id = #{dto.bookId}
and b.name like CONCAT('%', #{dto.bookName}, '%')
and b.id not in( select pb.book_id from permission_book pb where pb.user_id = #{dto.userId} and pb.deleted = 'n' )
